newly_discovered_gap.detail: App\Models is absent from the Domain forbidden-import list in ArchitectureRuleTest, yet 5 Domain files import it: SettlementRepositoryInterface, PartnerCommissionRepositoryInterface, PaymentRepositoryInterface, PaymentStatus, CampaignPricingEngine.
newly_discovered_gap.action_taken: None beyond documentation. The test was not weakened and no rule was removed. Adding the check with a 5-class allowlist is recommended so the debt becomes visible and cannot grow.
newly_discovered_gap.note: This debt was not captured in the Phase 0.15 debt register and is new information from Phases 0.17-0.18.

conclusion: Phases 0.17-0.18 introduced zero illegal dependencies and zero cycles while surfacing one previously unrecorded enforcement gap.
